title: Structure-Preserving Learning of Nonholonomic Dynamics
summary: Data-driven modeling is playing an increasing role in robotics and control, yet standard learning methods typically ignore the geometric structure of nonholonomic systems. As a consequence, the learned dynamics may violate the nonholonomic constraints and produce physically inconsistent motions. In this paper, we introduce a structure-preserving Gaussian process (GP) framework for learning nonholonomic dynamics.
